name: Krex
description: The Krex were a sentient species native to the planet Rokirex. Humanoid in shape, the species possessed a large build, five-fingered hands, big jaws and was taller than many other Humanoid species due to the large horn on top of their heads. A Krex named Grenkk worked at Club Vertica Casino as a bouncer during a Soovada event. In addition, General Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun was a Krex.
